title: FuzeEnvelopeV2
description: Event envelope v2 (FuzeSDLC governance/data-consistency-standard.md section 3). Language-neutral twin of EnvelopeV2Schema in shared/src/kafka/envelope.ts; the two are pinned to each other by packages/conformance-vectors/events/envelopes.*.json. Kafka partition key = aggregateId. `payload` is validated separately against the topic's own schema.

eventId.description: TypeID evt_..., minted at enqueue. Consumer dedupe key.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the topic's payload contract.

aggregateType.description: Entity type the event is about.

aggregateId.description: Typed id (TypeID) of the entity. Kafka partition key.

aggregateVersion.description: Monotonic per aggregate; bumped by the owner in the same transaction as the change. Ordering guard.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with a mandatory Z or numeric offset (the pattern enforces the offset; some format validators accept offset-less date-times).

causationId.description: eventId of the event that caused this one, if any.

payload.description: Topic-specific, schema-validated elsewhere. Any JSON value except absent.
